title.zh: 手机唱片：进度条走到底就不动了，切歌还会黑一下
title.en: Phone record: the bar stopped at the end, and a track change flashed empty

highlights.zh: 进度条读的是「从片段开始算了多少步」，却在第一步循环之后就被钳在 100%：chicago-house 16.6 秒、124 BPM，条在 1.94 秒就满了。现在按循环取余，它会一直转。
highlights.en: The bar read the step count since the clip began, then clamped at 100 % after the first loop: chicago-house is 16.6 s at 124 BPM, and the bar filled at 1.94 s. It is reduced modulo the loop now, so it keeps cycling.

highlights.zh: 切歌时封面会先清空再加载，唱片中间的图因此空白一段时间，看起来就是黑一下。现在旧封面留到新封面解码完成；解码过的封面按 URL 缓存。
highlights.en: Changing records cleared the cover before loading the next, so the artwork in the middle of the disc was blank for a moment — the flash. The previous cover now stays until the new one has decoded, and decoded covers are cached by URL.
